newsitem.title: USA: Neurocrine unit starts trial of DHEA.
newsitem.headline: Neurocrine unit starts trial of DHEA.

text.p: Neuroscience Pharma Inc, a unit of Neurocrine Biosciences, on Friday said it began a Phase II/III clinical trial in Canada of its compound neurosteroid DHEA, or dehydroepiandrosterone.
DHEA could potentially be used to treat memory deficits associated with Alzheimer's disease.
The double-blind, placebo-controlled study will be conducted by the Consortium of Canadian Centres for Clinical Cognitive Research in 18 locations.
Neuroscience Pharma expects to expand the trial to Europe later in the year.
